Eating it provides a temporary boost to your heat resistance.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Frozen Porgies are a type of [[Frozen Food]] that [[Link]] can make by freezing [[Armored Porgy|Armored Porgies]] or [[Mighty Porgy|Mighty Porgies]] with [[Ice]]. Eating one will restore one of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s and grant temporary [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Frozen Porgies reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Frozen Food]]. [[Link]] can make them by exposing [[Armored Porgy|Armored Porgies]] or [[Mighty Porgy|Mighty Porgies]] to either a [[Freezing Climate]] or [[Cold Water]]. When one is eaten, a single [[Heart]] will be restored to Link, and he will receive one level of temporary [[Heat Resistance]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Frozen Food * Porgy * Roasted Porgy }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Frozen Food, Health Restoring Items, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
